name: A Charming Tale
source:
Come join Prince Charming as he goes on a quest to  travel across the land, save damsels in distress, defeat evil villains, and of course find true love.  

Or not... up to you.
[From [url=https://red-baby.itch.io/acharmingtale] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
来加入查明王子的旅程吧：穿越大地、拯救受困少女、击败邪恶反派，当然还要寻找真爱。

或者不做这些……一切由你决定。

（来源：[url=https://red-baby.itch.io/acharmingtale]itch.io[/url]）
